title: mcp-import.server.ts keeps a module-level let extract model-call seam that tests swap and reset through setImportSeams.
evidence: (a) app/lib/mcp-import.server.ts:98 declares let extract = extractOrClassify. setImportSeams (:100-102) replaces it, and null restores it. Nothing else runs at import. (b) The only production reader is extractOne inside hostedImporter (:382). hostedImporter is built per call at app/lib/mcp.server.ts:225 from options {token, adapter, client, maxCorrectionAgeDays} (HostedImporterOptions, mcp-import.server.ts:300). Writers are tests only: mcp-import.server.test.ts (about 30 sets, resets in afterEach at :409, :671, :837), app/routes/mcp.hosted.test.ts:1455 with resets at :1473, :1802, :1883, and mcp.reviewer.test.ts:125. (c) Owner: add extract to HostedImporterOptions with extractOrClassify as the default, passed from the endpoint options (see the mcp.server lead). Tests already call hostedImporter directly, so they can pass it there. setImportSeams and its afterEach resets could then go. (d) Risk: route tests set this seam in a second module they never call directly, so a missed reset leaks a fake model into later cases in the same worker. Only tests write it, so a forgotten reset cannot reach production.
